To calculate the lexical density, we must determine the ratio of content words to total words in the text. Content words typically include nouns, main verbs, adjectives, and adverbs. Function words (such as pronouns, prepositions, conjunctions, articles, and auxiliary verbs) are excluded.

**Step 1: Tokenize and categorize the text.**
